$comment: Content evaluations for choose-proappstore-architecture (#171). test/skills-architecture.evals.test.ts checks, per scenario, that the recommended primitives appear in the decision tables, the cited clauses exist and are active in docs/standard/standard.json and are cited by the skill, unsupported needs are named in unsupported-requirements.md, the rejected substitutes are listed as 'do not use', and a worked example exists.

cases.title: personal notes app: D1 actions, search, counters, KV prefs
cases.requirements: one user's notes with tags, search, favourites count, theme preference

cases.title: agency CRM: membership scoping, roles, invites, batch, export
cases.requirements: agencies with members and roles; leads per org; CSV export; manager-only delete

cases.title: shared whiteboard: rooms for cursors/chat, actions for the record
cases.requirements: live cursors and chat for 20 people; boards persist; owner lock

cases.title: document library: storage with D1 metadata, permissions, safe rendering
cases.requirements: PDFs and images to 40 MB, private by default, public links, folder permissions, previews

cases.title: expiring tournament games: scheduled idempotent sweep
cases.requirements: games idle 15 minutes must be marked abandoned even if nobody is watching

cases.title: weekly third-party digest needs app code — scheduled SQL cannot provide it
cases.requirements: call an external API every Monday and transform its response in app-owned JavaScript

cases.title: app.storage.resize() does not exist — say so
cases.requirements: resize images on upload with app.storage.resize()

cases.title: Tailored vs Ready undecided — present trade-offs and stop
cases.requirements: unclear whether customers share a deployment
